cards.ex: I've been experiencing brain fog lately; I can't seem to focus on anything.
cards.exUz: Oxirgi paytlarda xotira tumanini his qilyapman; hech narsaga diqqatimni jamlay olmayapman.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni jamlash va eslash qobiliyatining vaqtincha susayishi.

cards.ex: Some degree of cognitive decline is normal as we age.
cards.exUz: Keksayganimizda aqliy pasayishning ma'lum darajasi normal holatdir.
cards.uzDef: Aqliy qobiliyatlarning, xususan, keksalikda yomonlashuvi.

cards.ex: I'm having more and more senior moments these days – where did I put my keys?
cards.exUz: Men shu kunlarda ko'proq keksalik lahzalarini boshdan kechirayapman - kalitlarimni qayerga qo'ydim?
cards.uzDef: Keksa odamlarda tez-tez uchraydigan kichik unutuvchanlik holatlari.

cards.ex: Doing puzzles and reading helps me stay sharp as I get older.
cards.exUz: Puzzle yechish va o'qish menga qariganimda zirak qolishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Aqliy qobiliyatni saqlab qolish, faol bo'lish.

cards.ex: Looking through old photos is always a walk down memory lane.
cards.exUz: Eski suratlarga qarash doim o'tmishga sayohatdir.
cards.uzDef: O'tmish voqealarni eslab, xotiralarga berilish.

cards.ex: You can see the ravages of time in the old building's crumbling facade.
cards.exUz: Eski binoning o'zilib tushayotgan jabhasida vaqtning vayronkorligini ko'rishingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan yuzaga keladigan o'zgarishlar, ayniqsa salbiy ta'sirlar.

cards.ex: I'm growing forgetful; I keep forgetting where I put things.
cards.exUz: Men unutuvchan bo'lib boryapman; narsalarni qayerga qo'yganimni unutaman.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan esda saqlash qobiliyatining pasayishi.

cards.ex: Her name is on the tip of my tongue, but I just can't remember it!
cards.exUz: Uning ismi tilim uchida, lekin eslay olmayapman!
cards.term: on the tip of my tongue
cards.uzDef: Eslab qolishga yaqin, lekin birdaniga eslay olmaslik.

cards.ex: She's enjoying her golden age, traveling the world and volunteering.
cards.exUz: U dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilib va ko'ngilli ravishda ishlagan holda o'zining oltin davridan bahramand bo'lmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Keksalikning baxtli va unumli davri.

cards.ex: I'm starting to lose track of what day it is.
cards.exUz: Qaysi kunligini unutib qo'yyapman.
cards.uzDef: Esdan chiqarmoq, unutib qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: That summer vacation is now just a distant memory.
cards.exUz: O'sha yozgi ta'til endi faqat uzoq xotira.
cards.uzDef: Ko'p yillar oldin bo'lgan voqea, xotira.

cards.ex: We need to understand the age-related changes that affect memory.
cards.exUz: Xotiraga ta'sir qiluvchi yoshga oid o'zgarishlarni tushunishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yosh o'tishi bilan tanada yuz beradigan fiziologik o'zgarishlar.

cards.ex: As time passes, the memory of that day slowly fades.
cards.exUz: Vaqt o'tishi bilan o'sha kun xotirasi asta-sekin so'nadi.
cards.uzDef: Xotiralar vaqt o'tishi bilan kamayib, xiralashib boradi.

cards.ex: The study investigated the causes of mental decline in older adults.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqot keksa yoshdagi odamlarda aqliy pasayish sabablarini o'rgandi.
cards.uzDef: Aqliy qobiliyatlarning yomonlashuvi, pasayishi.

cards.ex: She found a long-forgotten photograph in the attic.
cards.exUz: U chodirda qadimdan unutilgan suratni topdi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt oldin unutilgan.

cards.ex: It was just a fleeting memory, but it made me smile.
cards.exUz: Bu shunchaki o'tkinchi xotira edi, lekin meni tabassumga majbur qildi.
cards.uzDef: Tezda esdan chiqadigan xotira.

cards.ex: Age before beauty, let the older woman go first.
cards.exUz: Yosh kattaga hurmat, keksa ayol birinchi o'tsin.
cards.uzDef: Kattalarga hurmat ko'rsatish kerakligini ifodalovchi maqol.

cards.ex: Growing older is a privilege that many don't get to experience.
cards.exUz: Qarimoq - ko'pchilik tajriba qila olmaydigan imtiyoz.
cards.uzDef: Yosh o'tishi, keksa bo'lib borish.

cards.ex: Let's take a trip down memory lane and look at these old photo albums.
cards.exUz: Keling, xotiralar olamiga sayohat qilamiz va bu eski fotoalbomlarga qaraymiz.
cards.uzDef: O'tmish xotiralariga berilish, eski voqealarni eslash.

cards.ex: She spends her twilight years gardening and reading.
cards.exUz: U keksalik yillarini bog'dorchilik va o'qish bilan o'tkazadi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotning so'nggi yillari, keksalik davri.

cards.ex: He moved to another city, and soon he was out of sight, out of mind.
cards.exUz: U boshqa shaharga ko'chib o'tdi va tez orada ko'zdan uzoq, dildan uzoq bo'ldi.
cards.term: out of sight, out of mind
cards.uzDef: Agar ko'rinmasa, esdan chiqadi.

cards.ex: He maintained his mental acuity well into his nineties.
cards.exUz: U aqliy o'tkirligini to'qson yoshlarigacha saqlab qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Aqliy qobiliyatning o'tkirligi, aniqligi.

cards.ex: The details of the accident are now just a fading memory.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisa tafsilotlari endi shunchaki so'nayotgan xotira.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan kamayib borayotgan xotira.

cards.ex: I had a senior moment and forgot where I parked the car.
cards.exUz: Menda keksalik lahzasi bo'ldi va mashinani qayerga qo'yganimni unutdim.
cards.uzDef: Keksa odam unutuvchanlik qilgan holat.

cards.ex: She still runs marathons, proving that age is just a number.
cards.exUz: U hali ham marafon yuguradi va yosh shunchaki raqam ekanligini isbotlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Yoshga qarab hayotdan to'xtamaslik kerakligini ifodalovchi ibora.

cards.ex: Deep in my memory banks, I remembered the song.
cards.exUz: Xotira omborimning tubida men qo'shiqni esladim.
cards.uzDef: Xotiralarni saqlaydigan miyaning qismi.

cards.ex: Looking at old photos might jog your memory.
cards.exUz: Eski suratlarga qarash xotirangizni ishga solishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Eslashga yordam beradigan narsa qilmoq.

cards.ex: Eventually, age catches up with you, and you can't do the things you used to.
cards.exUz: Oxir-oqibat, yosh o'zini ko'rsatadi va siz ilgari qilgan ishlarni qila olmaysiz.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan tanadagi o'zgarishlar sezila boshlaydi.

cards.ex: The old song gave me a nostalgic feeling for my childhood.
cards.exUz: Eski qo'shiq menga bolaligim uchun sog'inch hissini berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishga bo'lgan sog'inch va quvonch hissi.

cards.ex: My grandmother needs long-term care due to her health problems.
cards.exUz: Buvim sog'lig'idagi muammolar tufayli uzoq muddatli parvarishga muhtoj.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida kasal yoki keksa odamga g'amxo'rlik qilish.
